proposition: Shāhrukh was declared the renewer (mujaddid) of the ninth Islamic century by Jalāl al-Dīn Qāyinī, a claim repeated by Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī and ʿAbd al-Razzāq Samarqandī; the pages do not say Ibn Turka made this claim.

mediation.who: Qāyinī, Yazdī and Samarqandī, as cited in Melvin-Koushki's footnote
mediation.note: court historiography; context for the ninth-century framing
